identity: UB Rupture-Chorale theft control. Singularity Rupture reads "Destroy all creatures, then any number of target players each mill half their library, rounded down" - it fills the OPPONENT'S graveyard twice over, once with their board and once with half their library. Chorale of the Void then reads "Whenever enchanted creature attacks, put target creature card from DEFENDING PLAYER'S graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking" - so every attack takes their best dead creature and that creature deals damage the same turn it arrives. The deck kills the opponent with their own creatures. Two hard constraints fall out of that and shape every slot: every removal spell must DESTROY rather than exile, because exiling denies Chorale its fuel, and the Void condition must be met at every one of your end steps or the Aura sacrifices itself. Elegy Acolyte and Umbral Collar Zealot solve the second one on their own.

identity_es: Control de robo Rupture-Chorale UB. Singularity Rupture dice "Destroy all creatures, then any number of target players each mill half their library, rounded down": llena el cementerio DEL RIVAL por partida doble, una vez con su tablero y otra con media biblioteca. Chorale of the Void dice entonces "Whenever enchanted creature attacks, put target creature card from DEFENDING PLAYER'S graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking", así que cada ataque se lleva su mejor criatura muerta y esa criatura hace daño el mismo turno en que llega. El mazo mata al rival con sus propias criaturas. De ahí salen dos restricciones duras que dan forma a cada hueco: cada hechizo de eliminación debe DESTRUIR en lugar de exiliar, porque exiliar le niega a Chorale su combustible, y la condición de Void debe cumplirse en todos y cada uno de tus pasos finales o el aura se sacrifica sola. Elegy Acolyte y Umbral Collar Zealot resuelven la segunda por sí solos.
